# Freeman

> Freeman is an HTTP engine for Python APIs on Django. A Rust HTTP server (Actix Web + Tokio) called through PyO3 does the routing, parameter checks, authentication, guards, CORS, rate limits and compression. The handler is plain Python, typed `async def` or `def`, and it can take and return Pydantic models or msgspec structs. The Django ORM, admin, auth and middleware still work. It is NOT a WSGI or ASGI application and needs no gunicorn or uvicorn: `python manage.py runbolt --processes N` is the server. Freeman began as a fork of django-bolt.

Key facts:
- Install: `pip install freeman`; add "freeman" to INSTALLED_APPS; write `api.py` with `api = BoltAPI()` and `@api.get(...)` handlers; run `python manage.py runbolt --dev`.
- Python 3.15 (CPython) and Django 6.1 only. Wheels for Linux x86_64, Linux arm64 and macOS arm64. MIT license.
- Features: typed path/query/header/cookie/form/body extraction; Pydantic models, msgspec.Struct and the `Serializer` class for bodies and results; JWT, API-key and session auth checked in Rust; guards `IsAuthenticated`, `AllowAny`, `Requires(claim, ...)`; `Depends()` dependency injection; `APIView` class-based views; pagination; CORS, rate limiting, gzip/brotli/zstd compression in Rust; Django middleware integration; WebSockets; Server-Sent Events and streaming; file responses; OpenAPI with Swagger, ReDoc, Scalar, RapiDoc, Stoplight at /docs; health checks; access log, metrics and tracing in Rust; lifespan hooks; ASGI mounts; MCP servers via the `bolt-mcp` package (needs a build with the `mcp` Cargo feature); in-process TestClient.
- Repository: https://github.com/nyssance/freeman

## Start here

- [Overview](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/index.md): what Freeman is and is not, hello-world, key features
- [FAQ](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/faq.md): is it stripped-down (no), WSGI (no), gunicorn needed (no), production ready, versions
- [How Freeman works](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/architecture.md): request path, Rust vs Python responsibilities, why it is fast
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/benchmarks.md): per-endpoint numbers with conditions, JS-runtime and Python-framework comparisons, reproduction commands
- [Comparison](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/comparison.md): Freeman vs Django Ninja vs Django REST Framework vs FastAPI vs Litestar
- [Quick Start](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/getting-started/quickstart.md): first API step by step
- [Deployment](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/getting-started/deployment.md): runbolt --processes, worker recycling, systemd, supervisor

## Topic guides

- [Routing](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/topics/routing.md)
- [Request handling](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/topics/requests.md): path, query, header, cookie, form, file, body parameters
- [Responses](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/topics/responses.md): JSON, HTML, redirect, file, streaming
- [Serializers](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/topics/serializers.md): msgspec-based Serializer with field sets and model integration

- [Authentication](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/topics/authentication.md): JWT, API key, session, refresh/revocation
- [Permissions](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/topics/permissions.md): IsAuthenticated, AllowAny, Requires
- [Class-based views](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/topics/class-based-views.md): APIView
- [Pagination](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/topics/pagination.md)
- [Dependencies](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/topics/dependencies.md): Depends()
- [Middleware](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/topics/middleware.md): CORS, rate limiting, custom, Django middleware integration
- [Compression](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/topics/compression.md)
- [Static files](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/topics/static-files.md) and [Media files](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/topics/media-files.md)
- [Lifespan](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/topics/lifespan.md), [Django signals](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/topics/signals.md), [Error handling](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/topics/error-handling.md), [Logging](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/topics/logging.md), [Health checks](https://github.com/nyssance/freeman/blob/main/docs/src/topics/health-checks.md)
